title: The Razer Soma Chroma has a silly name, silly price tag, and sillily requires you bring your own battery to light the thing up
summary: It's $500/£500 (about $954 AUD), which is a lot, and yes, there's RGB lighting in this, but Razer doesn't include an integrated battery (or even an optional one at checkout), doesn't pack a long enough cable, and doesn't include an adapter.
